issue.body: ## Versions `vize` **0.593.0** (npm), Node 26.6.0, macOS arm64. Nuxt 4 project shape, `ssr: false`. ## Reproduction Repro directory: `repro/xf-duplicate-id-routes/`. `nuxt.config.ts` ```ts export default defineNuxtConfig({ ssr: false, srcDir: "src" }); ``` `src/app.vue` ```vue ``` `src/layouts/default.vue` / `src/layouts/bare.vue` ```vue ``` ```vue ``` `src/pages/login.vue` / `src/pages/signup.vue` ```vue ``` ```vue ``` ``` $ vize lint -f plain --no-config --cross-file "src/**/*.vue" src/layouts/bare.vue:2:8 warning cross-file vize:croquis/cf/duplicate-id: Element ID 'shell' is used in 2 different locations across files src/pages/login.vue:6:12 warning cross-file vize:croquis/cf/duplicate-id: Element ID 'auth-page' is used in 2 different locations across files ``` ## Expected No findings. Only one layout and one leaf page are rendered at a time, so the same id in two layouts, or in two pages that are not parent and child routes, cannot be in the document together. The render graph that cross-file already builds for Nuxt (layouts → pages) knows this. ## Notes The rule is useful for components that can be on screen together; for files on different routes there is nothing to fix, and (see the directive issue) the finding cannot be suppressed on the line.

const routes = [router.resolve("/login"), router.resolve("/signup")];
</script>
<template><main><NuxtPage v-for="route in routes" :key="route.path" :route="route" /></main></template>

files.nuxt.config.ts:
import preset from "./router-preset";
export default defineNuxtConfig({ ...preset, ssr: false, srcDir: "src", pages: true, dir: { pages: "pages", layouts: "layouts" } });
files.router-preset.ts: export default { hooks: { "pages:extend"(pages) { const login = pages.find(p => p.path === "/login"); const signup = pages.find(p => p.path === "/signup"); login.children = [signup]; pages.splice(pages.indexOf(signup), 1); } } };
